ceu: ✦ The sextile between Venus and Jupiter

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: With the Moon in your house of partnerships, the balance between giving and receiving is at stake. Look for the middle ground.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, relationships and romance: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
With Mercury retrograde in your intimacy sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Ask the person beside you how you can help.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: The Moon asks for method and care with the details. A small adjustment to your routine makes a difference.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, routine and family: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
With Venus retrograde in your daily routine sector, people and feelings from the past may become important again.
s.d: Get up from your chair every hour and stretch.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: A day to shine without fear. What you do with passion is contagious to those around you.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, romance and conversations: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
With Mercury retrograde in your daily routine sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Show someone what you have created, without fear of criticism.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: The Moon passes through your area of home and family. It is a day to be close to those who give you roots.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, family and money: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
With Venus retrograde in your home and family sector, review what you value before making choices in love or money.
s.d: Offer help to someone in your family without waiting to be asked.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: Today your mind is quicker and more curious. Use it to settle pending matters in writing or in person.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, conversations and your image: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
With Mercury retrograde in your home and family sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Call a brother, sister, cousin or neighbour just to see how they are.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: With the Moon in your house of values, you crave comfort and concrete things. Choose with your head before you spend.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, money and your inner life: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
With Venus retrograde in your money sector, it is better to adjust what already exists than to start something new.
s.d: Tidy your wallet and your papers: order attracts clarity.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: Today the Moon visits your sign and puts your energy in the spotlight. People notice you more, so show your best side.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your image and friendships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
With Mercury retrograde in your money sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Say no to a request that takes you away from your priorities.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: A day for prayer, meditation or a simple walk on your own. The peace you find today stays with you.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your inner life and your career: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. An idea from today could become a real project.
With Venus retrograde in your inner life sector, people and feelings from the past may become important again.
s.d: Settle an old matter before starting something new.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: The Moon passes through your area of friends and projects. Good company gives you energy today.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, friendships and your horizons: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
With Mercury retrograde in your inner life sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Join a group or a conversation about a subject you enjoy.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: Today work and reputation carry emotional weight. Praise or criticism touches you more than usual.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your career and intimacy: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
With Venus retrograde in your career sector, review what you value before making choices in love or money.
s.d: Show your work: people who do not show up are not remembered.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: With the Moon in your house of wisdom, the day asks for meaning: ask yourself where you want to go, not just how.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your horizons and relationships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
With Mercury retrograde in your career sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Listen to a podcast or a talk on a new subject.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: The Moon touches intimacy and strong bonds. Open up to those who deserve it, and only to those who deserve it.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, intimacy and routine: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
With Venus retrograde in your intimacy sector, it is better to adjust what already exists than to start something new.
s.d: Write on a piece of paper what you want to be free of and tear it up.
